purpose: Sound-effect cue sheet for the Episode 9 main story. Cues are anchored to EDL v4 beat ids plus an offset in seconds, never to absolute timecode, so a retime moves them with their picture. Generated through ElevenLabs /v1/sound-generation and cached by prompt+duration.

policy.note: Effects must not be musical — score is a separate pass. Gains are linear multipliers applied before the dialogue mix; dialogue always wins.

cues.prompt: A large bird's talons scraping and pressing down on loose dry stone chips, close and dry, small grit skittering away, no music
A soft golden shimmer of sound rising and travelling away into open sky, like a struck singing bowl stretching into a long airy whoosh, warm and magical, no music
One deep old school bell struck once in cold mountain air with a long hollow ring, and beneath it heavy stone waking with a low grinding groan, no music
cues.note: Signature sound of the episode: the moment the broken gate wakes.

A heavy wooden staff driven hard into meadow earth with a solid thud and soil crunch, then a bright golden clasp snapping tight, no music
Three slow soft golden pulses rising up a wooden shaft, each a warm rounded chime with a gentle whoosh, evenly spaced, no music
cues.note: The staff rhythm motif — reused wherever the children must match the beat.
